educationalIntent.objective: Connect four hobby phrases with visual contexts and understand I like + -ing in short dialogues.
educationalIntent.successCriteria: Listen to all four children and identify drawing, reading comics, cycling, and taking photos.

content.instruction: Click each child. Listen to what they like doing.
content.completionMessage: Great listening! You heard all four children talk about their hobbies.

assets.alt: Four children drawing, reading a comic, preparing to ride a bicycle, and taking a photograph in a bright classroom.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I like drawing pictures. I draw after school.

turns.speaker: Ben
turns.text: I like reading comics. Space stories are my favorite!

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I like riding my bike. I ride in the park.

turns.text: I like taking photos. I take photos of my friends.
